title: Does Personifying an Agent Change What It Does
idiom: hand-coloured Victorian toy-catalogue wood engraving, two identical automatons, one given a character
hero_prompt: Hand-coloured wood engraving in the manner of a Victorian toy catalogue, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible engraved line and watercolour texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: two identical small clockwork automaton figures standing side by side at matching little workbenches; the left one bare brass, sorting cogs into a tidy row; the right one dressed in a bright red shawl and a feathered hat, a magpie perched on her shoulder, reaching playfully for a shiny trinket at the edge of her bench. Cream ground, brass, red and black.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a red ground, no shading or gradients: two identical simple clockwork doll figures side by side, the right one wearing a hat with a tall feather. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
